efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Oscar
negative_reviews.text: Food looked nothing like the menu photos, price is outrageous for the quality of what you’re eating. Ramen broth is bland and tastes boring, sides are extortionately expensive for what you receive. Wouldn’t recommend if you actually want to enjoy your meal whilst spending decent money.

negative_reviews.author: Hussein
negative_reviews.text: Not a great experience, not enough staff. Food was small portions and not very nice. All came separately and place smells weird.

negative_reviews.author: Salma Xx
negative_reviews.text: Food was overpriced £15/£19 for a bowl of noodles that dont have flavour apart from chili the portions are small and food is just basic. Service was not great food took ages to come and everyones foods were given at different times. The whole place stinks like damp and very stuffy. Dont recommend

negative_reviews.author: hatch waldon
negative_reviews.text: This restaurant scammed me and overcharged my card. They are not responding to my emails either. Sad because the food was actually good. In the end, I had to contact my bank to get the overcharged amount refunded

negative_reviews.author: Tano D'Amore
negative_reviews.text: We booked a table but when we showed up they told us that they didn't have any broth available... The lady told me that they have only vegan options...They could have tell us before we travel there. So not a good experience for us, we have to leave without eating.
